name: Sonoma Valley Zen Group
reason: Too thin: its own site (sonomavalleyzen.org, a three-page Wix site, robots.txt allows) offers only weekly Zoom sittings with study on Thursdays and morning zazen, one in-person meeting a month and 'other practice opportunities' by email; there are no programme pages, talks, videos or retreats with URLs of their own, and the only photos are on static.wixstatic.com, which the brief records as refusing our robots.txt request (not re-tested). Email contact@sonomavalleyzen.com was published. Guiding teacher Rev. Myogen Kathryn Stark (co-founder Silver John Hall died in 2024).
